_comment: Packages named by the master brief (stack: Expo + TypeScript, Cloudflare Worker, Vitest + fast-check, H3, Expo push). Anything else needs the human: the dependency guard asks before it is installed. Add a package here only after the human approves it. 2026-11-14: the human asked for a linter; Biome (lint and format in one tool) was chosen over ESLint plus Prettier, so eslint, typescript-eslint and prettier are not used.
